title: Aphorism § 105
text:
§ 105



 The second point of the business of a true physician related to
          acquiring a knowledge of the instruments intended for the cure of the natural diseases,
          investigating the pathogenetic power of the medicines, in order, when called on to cure,
          to be able to select from among them one, from the list of whose symptoms an artificial
          disease may be constructed, as similar as possible to the totality of the principal
          symptoms of the natural disease sought to be cured.
